ordering: Pinned source config order; match input annotations by source_landmark_id, never array position or paper table row.

source_coordinates.origin: top-left; no automatic half-pixel or one-based shift
source_coordinates.ground_truth: float mean of junior and senior coordinates matched by stable ID; no ceil
source_coordinates.source_loader_difference: Upstream uses ceil(mean) and positional pairing. Compare its rounded target in supplementary evaluation; do not silently reproduce bias.

clinical_protocol_status: Definitions are descriptive mappings to Aariz; clinician sign-off remains required, especially Gn/Go/Ar/Po.
